question: Does routing contiguous regions rather than whole antigens buy remote-tier quality at a smaller disclosure cost?
note: Every antigen is normalised by an ECDF fitted on the other antigens, so no antigen enters its own transform. The budget is a deployment constraint and is held fixed, not fitted. In nested_region the window length is chosen on the remaining antigens and applied to the held-out one; the frontier instead reports the best window per budget and is therefore an upper envelope, not an out-of-sample claim.
